show.description: On their honeymoon in a remote cottage, newlyweds Amey and Radhika step into a nightmare they never saw coming. They are stalked by Malati, a hauntingly beautiful and bloodthirsty spirit obsessed with one thing, possessing Amey forever. As love turns into terror, tension and forbidden dark romance spiral into a chilling horror saga.
